description: Na₅SiP₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are five inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to five P³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.42 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.33 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four P³⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.24 Å. In the fourth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four P³⁻ atoms to form NaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent SiP₄ tetrahedra, corners with five NaP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaP₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiP₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.83-2.89 Å. In the fifth Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four P³⁻ atoms to form NaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent SiP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaP₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.02 Å. Si⁴⁺ is bonded to four P³⁻ atoms to form SiP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaP₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiP₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Si-P bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.34 Å. There are three inequivalent P³⁻ sites. In the first P³⁻ site, P³⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to seven Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Si⁴⁺ atoms. In the second P³⁻ site, P³⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to eight Na¹⁺ and one Si⁴⁺ atom. In the third P³⁻ site, P³⁻ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to seven Na¹⁺ and one Si⁴⁺ atom.
